name: Wonder Classic White Sandwich Bread (Ultra-Soft)
whyItWorks: Refined enriched wheat flour with all bran and germ removed. Wonder bread has a cloud-soft texture that turns to smooth mush upon chewing, presenting zero abrasive roughage to the GI tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: The ideal vehicle for flare-safe deli turkey sandwiches or light cinnamon toast.
watchOuts: Low in fiber by design (0.5g); perfect for low-residue flare protocols.
